brief:
Israeli authorities have recorded 2,347 deaths since the start of the war three years ago, the Hebrew-language Kan channel reported. The toll includes 1,318 military personnel and members of Israeli security services killed within Israeli territory.

The figure encompasses fatalities across the conflict's duration, though the report does not specify the geographic scope beyond deaths occurring in Israel itself or provide a breakdown by conflict zone.
title: Israel reports 2,347 war deaths after three years of fighting
